raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misread the SERP snippets and incorrectly stated that Marcello Pagliero “died in London, England,” conflating his birthplace (London) with his death place. The visible snippets (Wikipedia, IMDb) clearly indicated he died in Paris, France. This reflects overreliance on (and misinterpretation of) search snippets without opening and verifying authoritative sources.
